notes: attempt-1 was an exploratory data inspection (no RESULT lines). Final script: airframe_data.dta restricted to type fighter or bomber, 1918-1935; continuous two-piece linear spline in year with knot at 1926 (yr_before = min(year,1926), yr_after = max(year-1926,0)); OLS with HC1 robust SEs. US-only columns: log wing load / log max speed on the spline plus constant. US-UK columns: pooled US+UK fighters/bombers with a common spline (the UK spline), a US indicator, and the spline interacted with the US indicator; the interaction coefficients are reported as the US-relative slopes. No engine controls. Engine column: engine_data.dta (Jane's, which appears already limited to engines used in fighters/bombers: US+UK rows = 123, matching the Table 4 pooled N), US only, log hp per lb on the spline, a liquid-cooled indicator and a constant. Observation counts are the regression Ns. No weights.
